title: Cursor-anchored rejection label can still overlap the strain legend at (12, 76) despite 'never collides' claim
evidence:
+	// construction (valid vs invalid) — so it never collides with the
+	// strain-legend row at (12, 76).
+			draw_text(app, reject_label(app.drag.valid), i32(cur.x)+12, i32(cur.y)-14, 16, rl.Color{200, 60, 60, 255})
detail: Label position is cursor plus (12, -14), so a cursor at screen (0, 90) draws it exactly at (12, 76), on the strain legend. Mutual exclusivity with the cost label prevents label-vs-label collision only; it says nothing about the legend.
recommended_fix: Clamp the rejection label offset so it cannot land on the legend region, or soften the comment's absolute 'never collides' claim.

title: Unconditional to_screen computes cur on paths that draw nothing
evidence:
-			cur := rnd.to_screen(&app.view, app.drag.wx, app.drag.wy)
+		cur := rnd.to_screen(&app.view, app.drag.wx, app.drag.wy)
detail: cur was hoisted out of the conditional, so it is computed even when neither branch draws: Glow_Only with valid == .None, or Full with a live ok preview. Wasteful per-frame transform with no consumer.
recommended_fix: Guard the to_screen call with the disjunction of both draw conditions, or compute it inside each branch that draws.

title: Comment claims Glow_Only shows no numbers, but rejection label draws in every assist mode
evidence:
+	// (never two numbers at the cursor); Glow_Only shows no numbers at all;
+			draw_text(app, reject_label(app.drag.valid), i32(cur.x)+12, i32(cur.y)-14, 16, rl.Color{200, 60, 60, 255})
detail: The rejection branch has no assist-mode guard, so an invalid drag in Glow_Only still draws a number at the cursor, contradicting 'Glow_Only shows no numbers at all' in the same hunk.
recommended_fix: Qualify the comment to say 'no cost numbers' in Glow_Only, or add the assist-mode guard to the rejection branch if the intent is truly no numbers.

title: Rejection label can render off-screen near the top edge (negative y)
evidence:
-			draw_text(app, reject_label(app.drag.valid), 12, 76, 16, rl.Color{200, 60, 60, 255})
+			draw_text(app, reject_label(app.drag.valid), i32(cur.x)+12, i32(cur.y)-14, 16, rl.Color{200, 60, 60, 255})
detail: Position is cur.y - 14 with no clamping; a cursor within 14 px of the window top yields negative y, drawing the warning off-screen. Previously fixed at (12, 76), the label was always visible.
recommended_fix: Clamp y to at least 0 (or flip the offset below the cursor near edges) so the rejection warning stays visible during edge drags.
